snapshot.title: Who we build for
snapshot.description: Early-stage founders validating a first version, and growing SaaS teams scaling past their first hundred customers.

snapshot.title: What we build
snapshot.description: Multi-tenant architecture, billing and metering, role-based access, onboarding flows, and the analytics that prove it's working.

snapshot.title: What matters most
snapshot.description: Time-to-value for new users, retention past the trial window, and a system that doesn't need a rebuild at the next growth stage.

problems: Trial signups that don't convert to paid because onboarding takes too long to reach value
Billing logic hardcoded around the first pricing model, breaking the moment plans change
No clean way to separate tenant data as the customer base grows past the first few accounts
Admin and customer-facing dashboards built as an afterthought, not a real product surface
Feature flags and permissions managed by hand instead of by a real access model
Analytics that can't answer basic retention or activation questions with confidence
Integrations (Stripe, CRM, SSO) bolted on individually instead of designed as a system
Technical debt from the MVP phase slowing every release six months post-launch
No clear ownership of the codebase after the original founding engineers move on
outcomes: A billing system that survives your next three pricing changes, not just the current one
Onboarding that gets new users to their first real result inside one session
Dashboards your team opens because they trust the numbers, not despite them
A permissions and tenancy model that scales past your next 10x in customers
Clean, documented handover so you're never dependent on one person's memory
A codebase your next engineering hire can actually ramp up on quickly

faqs.q: We already have an MVP — can you take over from here?
faqs.a: Yes. Most SaaS engagements start with a codebase audit so we understand what's there before proposing changes, rather than recommending a rebuild by default.

faqs.q: Do you build multi-tenant architecture from scratch?
faqs.a: We do, and we'll also tell you honestly if single-tenant with a later migration path is the faster, cheaper route for your current stage.

faqs.q: Can you integrate with Stripe, our CRM, or our existing auth provider?
faqs.a: Yes — integration work like this is a large share of what we do for SaaS clients specifically, not a bolt-on afterthought.

faqs.q: What if our pricing model changes mid-build?
faqs.a: We design billing logic to expect that — plans, metering, and entitlements are built as configurable data, not hardcoded assumptions.

faqs.q: How involved do we need to be during the build?
faqs.a: Weekly demos and shared board visibility are standard, but day-to-day involvement scales to what your team has time for — from hands-on to lightly-checked-in.

faqs.q: Can you help after launch, not just build and leave?
faqs.a: Yes — LLMOps & AI Observability, Website Maintenance & Support, and a Dedicated Development Team all exist specifically for the ongoing work after v1 ships.
